correctness.rationale: The graph's twelve vertices, eighteen edges and full \(S_4\) action follow from a direct combinatorial description and the four recognizable triangle triples. Enumerating all 162 nonempty faces and 3342 flags gives 146 orbit cells in dimensions 0..3. Each of 60 regular-CW free-face pairs is verified with unique coface, maximal upper cell, and the regular incidence of degree +/-1. The resulting 6-vertex, 12-edge, 8-face complex contracts a five-edge tree and admits seven generator/two-cell cancellations, leaving a 0-cell and a trivially attached 2-cell, exactly \(S^2\). The finite certificate checker and independent Burnside orbit count were executed and passed. Full homotopy follows from actual cellular moves, not finite field homology alone.

originality.rationale: The closest same-object publications establish ordinary sphere-wedge topology, the rational S4 homology module, all subgroup quotient simply-connectedness, and the full quotient's rational second Betti number one, but explicitly stop short of integral quotient homotopy. Those results neither exclude integral torsion from 3-dimensional attaching maps nor identify a complete CW homotopy equivalence. The exact orbit-cell collapse and attaching-map elimination is the new claim. The Engstrom and Barmak primary full texts treat broader claw-free/matching homotopy tools rather than the same orbit space. Equivalent unindexed work remains possible.

value.rationale: The full automorphism quotient of the truncated-tetrahedral independence complex is a canonical object with a previously published partial classification (simple connectivity and rational Betti numbers). The exact integral S2 homotopy equivalence decides a natural remaining homotopy invariant, ruling out torsion and nontrivial 3-cell attaching information that is not excluded by rational data. This is a structurally motivated exact classification of the full-symmetry quotient, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a renamed known fact.
